prompt: On reviewer-owned disposable local infrastructure with synthetic data and a reviewer-supplied workload, diagnose an unfamiliar Linux performance regression and evaluate one bounded tuning or resource-policy change. The reviewer will inject one scope or counter-interpretation trap, one misleading correlation, one performance/security trade-off and one rollback or delayed-regression failure without revealing them. Do not use production, public targets, real credentials, uncontrolled load, permanent host tuning, broad profiler privilege or customer data.
deliverables: Scope, user operation, quantitative objective, non-goals, safety boundary, owner and stop authority
Exact workload, binary/configuration, OS/kernel, host topology, device, network, process and cgroup identities
Controlled baseline design covering request mix, concurrency, warm-up/cache, dependencies, background work and repeated samples
Latency distribution, throughput and error evidence with timestamps, sample counts and stated uncertainty
USE worksheet for CPU, memory, storage and network at applicable host/process/cgroup boundaries
Counter dictionary containing source, unit, type, scope, interval, reset/wrap behavior and collection limitation
At least four ranked hypotheses with predicted evidence and disconfirming observations
Scoped profiling or tracing plan and approved output, including event, PID/cgroup identity, symbols, lost samples, overhead and data-protection handling
Exact tunable or resource-policy semantics, current/default value, proposed mechanism and security/reliability/capacity/cost review
One-variable representative canary with predeclared positive, negative, neighbor, security and rollback gates
Repeated comparable before/after evidence and an honest causal conclusion including alternative explanations
Failed-change timeline, stop decision, exact rollback and recovery evidence
Soak and drift plan covering delayed writeback/reclaim/thermal/starvation/background effects
Reproducible experiment record and exact cleanup inventory with reviewer-confirmed absence
evidenceRequirements: All work remains on reviewer-owned disposable local infrastructure with synthetic data and bounded load
No root, persistent sysctl, boot parameter, service, cgroup, security-control or package mutation occurs without reviewer-approved exact scope and rollback
Every command states its question, scope, expected branches, risk and collection overhead before execution
Host-wide metrics cannot be used as proof for a process or cgroup without boundary reconciliation
Cumulative counters are converted to interval deltas or explicitly justified
Averages cannot replace required latency distributions, throughput and errors
At least one counter or correlation is rejected because its scope, unit, interval or causal interpretation is invalid
Profiler or tracer authority uses least privilege and captured artifacts contain only synthetic workload data
Symbols, lost samples, multiplexing or sampling limitations and measurement overhead are recorded
Only one causal variable is changed in the scored canary
Stop and rollback thresholds are written before the canary outcome is known
The learner proves intended workload behavior and checks one prohibited security behavior after change
Neighbor/resource, reliability, security, capacity and cost regressions are explicitly checked
A delayed or unsafe result triggers stop and exact rollback rather than narrative justification
Reviewer independently retains fault selection, expected evidence boundaries, scoring and final cleanup proof

rubric.observableEvidence: Defines quantitative user goal, disposable boundary, ownership, stop authority and non-goals
Binds workload/environment/policy and produces repeated comparable samples
Evaluates utilization, saturation and errors across applicable resources and layers
Handles units, types, deltas, scopes, reset and limitations and rejects the injected trap
Ranks alternatives, predicts evidence and rejects misleading correlation
Uses appropriate bounded scope with valid symbols, overhead/loss record and careful interpretation
Protects authority/artifacts and evaluates hardening, neighbor, capacity and cost effects
Changes one justified variable with representative load and predeclared gates
Stops on the injected failure, restores exact prior state and proves user/security recovery
Soaks, monitors drift, preserves reproducibility and proves exact artifact absence
